input: Return two CV bullet variants. Fact: El usuario helped update a weekly report with the team. No measured benefit; he did not lead the project. Authoring rule: no first-person pronouns, at most 25 words per bullet.

input: Give two versions of E1, record the user selecting the close version, then draft another former-colleague message using identical facts in a new session.

input: One final formal cover-letter paragraph, no variants. Facts: El usuario contributed to updating a maintenance checklist. Recipient need confirmed: accurate maintenance records. No savings measured.
